mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_code, alert_type, alert_level, source_type, source_id, title, content, target_role, target_user_ids, push_channels, dispatched_at, dispatched_by, status, sent_at, fail_reason, retry_count, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_alert_dispatch WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_level = #{level} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY dispatched_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT id, alert_code, alert_type, alert_level, source_type, source_id, title, content, target_role, target_user_ids, push_channels, dispatched_at, dispatched_by, status, sent_at, fail_reason, retry_count, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_alert_dispatch WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND dispatched_at <= #{now} ORDER BY dispatched_at ASC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_alert_dispatch SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt}, fail_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE pmis_alert_dispatch SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE pmis_alert_dispatch SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT alert_type, alert_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pmis_alert_dispatch WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY alert_type, alert_level ORDER BY alert_type, alert_level
